node.label: Floods, landslides & GLOFs
node.summary: Floods, landslides and glacial lake outburst floods.

facts.text: Odisha: a landslide at Dangeshi village (Raikia block, **Kandhamal**) killed three; post-Cyclone Arnab floods hit 84,564 people in Ganjam, Gajapati and Kandhamal; ₹4 lakh aid per death.

facts.text: A **glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF)** in **Bhutan** put north Bengal's Darjeeling hills and **Dooars** on alert; 4,000+ people were moved in **Kumargram** and **Tufanganj** as the **Sankosh** river rose.
